notes_for_editor: No build year, staffing, fire history or removal date was found; two web searches turned up nothing on this tower. The Forest Lookouts page is the only source that says Removed, and the register description is a single sentence. The Forest Fire Lookout Association Virginia index flags Rich Hole as a possible duplicate ('same as White Rock?') and lists a separate Mill Mountain tower (Bath / Rockbridge, 38.07240, -79.49338, Gone); check whether these are one site. The same index also places FFLOS US 1706 beside a White Rock in Lee County and Harlan (KY); the Bath coordinates match the register, so the Bath entry is used.
